model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different language models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various Indo-European (IE) language families, as well as on Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic languages. The vertical axis represents the effect, which is a numerical value indicating the performance or impact of the models on the languages, with a scale that ranges from 0 to 30. The horizontal axis lists the language families and types, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. Each language family has a set of bars corresponding to the different models, with each bar's height representing the effect value. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the models, and error bars are present to show the variability or confidence interval of the effect. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars, and it does not provide any annotations or additional information beyond the visual representation of the data.
